QUOTE: "That's the root problem: the interface has no way to report an error, so the failure is silent at every layer above it." and "`do_count_tokens` (`:825`) returns `0`... a C API consumer gets a count of 0 with no error code."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: It says failure is indistinguishable from empty input (contract "empty on failure or empty input"), and callers (count_tokens, generate paths) have no check, though some check size<2 without distinguishing the tokenizer failure.
